scope: Exact runtime-owned VB graphical CheckBox and OptionButton with BS_PUSHLIKE and public BS_BITMAP or BS_ICON payloads.
root_cause: S13 deliberately rejected every image-bearing graphical choice. The existing generic BUTTON painter already obtains image handles with BM_GETIMAGE and borrows rather than owns them, so that blanket rejection unnecessarily excluded the matching public-protocol subset.
minimal_fix: Keep the exact runtime-owner and checkbox/radio type gates; remove only the BS_BITMAP/BS_ICON rejection. Reuse the existing painter and leave BM_GETIMAGE/BM_SETIMAGE ownership, checked state, grouping, notifications, fonts and geometry with the runtime.

native_proofs.fixture: Project-authored C17 non-USER-BUTTON runtime model. It is not a claim that an arbitrary VB image property or private object is supported.
native_proofs.native_fallback_x64_and_x86: The same fixture reports styled=0 and retains its native public state/image protocol without injection.
native_proofs.existing_regression: core-vb direct injected child passed x64 and x86, including graphical role transition and explicit WM_SETFONT destruction/reentrancy retirement. Standard private-desktop CTest remains unavailable in this session because CreateDesktopW returned access denied; no visible-desktop result is claimed.

package.mode: Dual-width Ninja rebuild and strict manually assembled same-snapshot four-file candidate; package checker and x64 launcher into x64/x86 fixture tests passed.
package.publication: The exact candidate hashes were verified in both assets/ and O:\winnt\system32, then the assets package reran the injected x64 and x86 graphical-choice probes.

not_supported: A real VB image-property sample was not available in the frozen inputs; this is a public-protocol model proof only.
BS_OWNERDRAW and unknown/complex graphical variants remain native.
There is no valid CheckBox/OptionButton default-button analogue in the admitted style set; it remains outside this change.
No physical mouse/keyboard or visible-desktop assertion is made by the native probes.
invariants: No ABI, component/product count, original graphic resource, title, menu, font or scrollbar implementation changed. Image handles are neither replaced nor deleted by the renderer.
